capabilities: Show a copy button beside formatted inline content
Copy inline code, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlights, headings, tags and links
Toggle all copy buttons on or off with a command
Skip Meta Bind and Dataview inline syntax by default
Choose the button icon and enable a copy notification
disambiguation: Not a file or note copier; it copies the text of formatted inline content.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; can be installed through BRAT for testing; interface available in English, Chinese and Russian.
problem: Copying formatted content such as inline code, a tag or a link means selecting the text by hand, which is slow and awkward in reading mode.
summary: Adds a copy button next to inline code, bold, italic, highlights, headings, tags and links in both editing and reading modes.
